caveats: Counts do not provide boundaries, membership lists, service capacity or population coverage. Different unit types describe overlapping administrative systems and cannot be added as a single count. Batticaloa’s 346 GN divisions are a statistical count; the source says there are 345 territorial divisions. Matale’s 532 GN divisions reflect reservoir-related removals. Ampara’s DS/AGA figure includes the Kalmunai North sub-secretariat. The table reflects five council upgrades in 2023, giving 29 Municipal Councils and 36 Urban Councils nationally; this differs from the classifications in some earlier financial returns. A source dash retains nil-or-negligible status and is not made into a numerical zero.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One reported count by district and administrative-unit type at 19 December 2025
